p:cNvPr.descr: An illustration of the stages of oxidation. In stage 1, CH3 bonds down and right to CH2, which bonds down and left to CH2, which bonds down and right to CH2, which bonds down and left to CH2, which bonds down and right to CH2, which bonds down and left to CH2, which bonds down and right to CH2, which bonds down and left to CH2, which bonds down and right to CH2, which bonds down and left to CH2, which bonds down and right to CH2, which bonds down and left to CH2, which bonds down and right to CH2, which bonds down and left to CH2, which bonds down and right to C, which double bonds right to O and bounds down to O-. Each bond line going down and left has a blue line cross over it. Red arrows from those all point to 28e-. An arrow then points to NADH, FADH2 in a pink box. To the right of this chain is beta oxidation in a blue box. Under this box is a blue arrow points to 8 Acetyl-CoA in a tan box in stage 2. Under that box is a blue arrow pointing down to arrows going right and in a circle, identified as citric acid cycle. At the bottom right of this circle is an arrow pointing to 16CO2. A red arrow leaves this circle, with 64e- in the middle, pointing to NADH, FADH2 in the pink box, which covers all three stages. Below this box, in stage 3, a red arrow (with e- on the right of the arrow) points to respiratory (electron-transfer) chain in a blue box. Under that is a curved blue arrow going from ADP [plus] Pi to ATP in an orange oval. to the right of the box is a curved blue arrow goes from 2H+ [plus] 1/2O2 pointing to H2O.
